chapter: Pictures and memories of her father
title: Louis Armstrong leaving for Chicago and being taught harmony
summary: Armstrong asked her father to go to Chicago but he stayed; her father taught Armstrong harmony from a large book at home.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Now, another thing I remember about him when Lois Armstrong was leaving here to go to Chicago. Wasn't it Chicago?
He asked my daddy to go with him.
He said, if we do well, we'll stay, and if we don't, we'll come back. But my daddy wouldn't leave. But Lois Armstrong went on.
You mentioned that your father helped him with some harmony or some kind of music?
He taught him harmony. Taught him harmony.
He had a large book, and he, several times, lots of times, he'd come home and my daddy would teach him that.
Did he bring his coronet with him or? Oh, yes.
Always had his instrument with him. I was quite a little girl, but I remember him.
